opt-invkey-hint: Your inventory key opens THIS window instead of the vanilla one - handy when mounted and unable to look at the animal's saddlebags. In creative mode the key opens the creative catalog AND this window together, so your inventory stays reachable while you build. Turn this off to get the vanilla behaviour back.
opt-adjacent-hint: One right-click on a chest also opens every chest of the same kind nearby, docking the whole wall into the window at once. Locked or claimed chests stay shut.
opt-mount-hint: Elk saddlebags and pack-animal bags of the mount you are riding appear in the window automatically. Nearby boats open all their crates at once.
